rows.en: ...I'm sorry for all the trouble, Kunugi.
rows.notes: Context and grammatical subjects verified against original neighboring scene uses; no special ambiguity.

rows.en: No... I haven't done anything worth mentioning.
rows.notes: Context and grammatical subjects verified against original neighboring scene uses; no special ambiguity.

rows.en: Oh, come now. You went to a lot of trouble, didn't you? For that boy and #部隊名.
rows.notes: Rikudo addresses Kunugi; that boy is Ayato, supported by blood-color discussion and custody scene. Squad placeholder preserved.

rows.en: ...I envy you, Professor. You don't seem to care at all what color someone's blood is.
rows.notes: Professor preserves the respectful academic address without inventing a personal name. Blood color is literal human/Mulian difference.

rows.en: How can I be like you, Professor?
rows.notes: Context and grammatical subjects verified against original neighboring scene uses; no special ambiguity.

rows.en: Oh, it's simple... Just sit down and share a meal with them. Then you'll understand.
rows.notes: Rikudo asks Kunugi to share food with the people whose blood differs; them restores the contextual object.
Silence retained.

rows.en: ...Listen, Kunugi. We live in an age when people from different home planets meet.
rows.notes: Home planets plural preserves the broad interplanetary coexistence argument rather than narrowing it to Mu.

rows.en: Don't you think a difference in blood color is a trivial thing?
rows.notes: Context and grammatical subjects verified against original neighboring scene uses; no special ambiguity.

rows.en: And #部隊名 is living proof of that...
rows.notes: Sentence is completed grammatically in English while retaining trailing reflective ellipsis.

rows.en: That's why you stood up for them too, isn't it? ...For the sake of the future.
rows.notes: Kunugi defended Ayato and the squad; the future is their coexistence, not a new tactical objective.

rows.en: ...Is that really why?
rows.notes: Context and grammatical subjects verified against original neighboring scene uses; no special ambiguity.

rows.en: Heh heh... I'm sure it is.
rows.notes: Context and grammatical subjects verified against original neighboring scene uses; no special ambiguity.

rows.en: Now, won't you stay for a meal? I've got some fine sake too. Oh, yes... Shirow brought me something to go with it earlier...
rows.notes: Shirow is source given name of Shirow Watari, not surname Watari. Sake/snack pairing preserves the cultural food context.

rows.en: Pond smelt, a specialty of Lake Ashi in Hakone. They're a little out of season, but would you like some?
rows.notes: Rikudo offers Kunugi fish accompanying sake. Root verified wakasagi as Japanese pond smelt from Japan Tourism Agency text and Hakone/Lake Ashi official spelling; regional specialty and slight off-season qualification both retained.

rows.en: Yes... I'd be glad to, Professor.
rows.notes: Context and grammatical subjects verified against original neighboring scene uses; no special ambiguity.

rows.en: This time might be too much for him... That idiot probably won't recover. Unlike you and me, he's so sensitive.
rows.notes: Asuka addresses Rei about Shinji; him identifies Shinji, whose gender is sourced in glossary. Sensitive conveys fragile nerves, not physical injury.

rows.en: ...Shinji hasn't woken up at all.
rows.notes: Context and grammatical subjects verified against original neighboring scene uses; no special ambiguity.

rows.en: He's not hurt. He'll come to sooner or later.
rows.notes: Context and grammatical subjects verified against original neighboring scene uses; no special ambiguity.
Silence retained for all four original uses.

rows.en: ...I thought everyone in #部隊名 had helped him become more positive... But this time, well...
rows.notes: He=Shinji; thought=Asuka. Source trails off on this time; English retains hesitant unfinished evaluation.

rows.en: ...Aren't you worried about Shinji?
rows.notes: Context and grammatical subjects verified against original neighboring scene uses; no special ambiguity.

rows.en: D-don't be ridiculous! Why should I have to worry about that idiot Shinji!?
rows.notes: Self-important why should I and idiot preserve Asuka denial, stutter, and insult strength.

rows.en: W-what's with that look...!?
rows.notes: Context and grammatical subjects verified against original neighboring scene uses; no special ambiguity.

rows.en: I am a little worried, of course! Idiot or not, he's a friend who's fought alongside us all this time...!
rows.notes: Friend/alongside us preserves comrade relationship plus shared history; denial is qualified, not total.

rows.en: ...A friend...
rows.notes: Deliberate echo fragment of friend; no grammatical subject was omitted.

rows.en: But only a little, a little! Don't get the wrong idea!
rows.notes: Repeated little retains Asuka repeated insistence and defensive tone.

rows.en: ...Still, this is unusual. You worrying about someone else, I mean.
rows.notes: Context and grammatical subjects verified against original neighboring scene uses; no special ambiguity.

rows.en: Is it?
rows.notes: Context and grammatical subjects verified against original neighboring scene uses; no special ambiguity.

rows.en: Honestly, that idiot Shinji... I wonder if he's dreaming right now?
rows.notes: Context and grammatical subjects verified against original neighboring scene uses; no special ambiguity.

rows.en: Dreaming?
rows.notes: Context and grammatical subjects verified against original neighboring scene uses; no special ambiguity.

rows.en: Yes. Have you... never had a dream?
rows.notes: Dream means sleeping dream, not aspiration, settled by Shinji dream sequence immediately following.
Intentional silence; same source row also used at battle-map uses409,587,600, all contexts checked.

rows.en: ...Shinji, why did you do that?
rows.notes: Rei addresses Shinji in dream; that remains deliberately unspecific because source does not name the prior incident here.

rows.en: I couldn't forgive him... My father. My father, who betrayed me.
rows.notes: Repeated father preserves emphasis; the apposition is deliberate source structure, not dropped grammatical subject.

rows.en: My father doesn't understand how I feel at all.
rows.notes: Context and grammatical subjects verified against original neighboring scene uses; no special ambiguity.

rows.en: Did you try to understand how your father feels, Shinji?
rows.notes: Context and grammatical subjects verified against original neighboring scene uses; no special ambiguity.

rows.en: ...There's no way I could. My father never tells me anything.
rows.notes: Context and grammatical subjects verified against original neighboring scene uses; no special ambiguity.

rows.en: That's right... Not about Mom, not about Toji... Nothing... Nothing!
rows.notes: Reuses preceding explicit father-never-tells frame; not about Mom/Toji are deliberate echoed fragments.

rows.en: And yet my father tried to make me kill Toji! He didn't even try to save him!
rows.notes: Father=Gendo, me=Shinji, him=Toji. Father tried to force Shinji to kill Toji and did not attempt rescue.

rows.en: If Ayato hadn't come, I would have done something I could never take back!
rows.notes: Irreversible act retains euphemistic source wording; scene identifies near killing Toji without adding explicit murder.

rows.en: That's why I can't forgive him...! I can't forgive my father!
rows.notes: Context and grammatical subjects verified against original neighboring scene uses; no special ambiguity.

rows.en: Then what will you do?
rows.notes: Context and grammatical subjects verified against original neighboring scene uses; no special ambiguity.

rows.en: I... I just can't...
rows.notes: Deliberate unfinished breakdown; no completed decision is added.

rows.en: That's how you keep running away from things you don't like.
rows.notes: Context and grammatical subjects verified against original neighboring scene uses; no special ambiguity.

rows.en: So what!? What's wrong with running away from things I don't like!?
rows.notes: Context and grammatical subjects verified against original neighboring scene uses; no special ambiguity.

rows.en: I've reached my limit! I don't want to fight anymore! Not when I nearly killed my friend!!
rows.notes: Friend=Toji; preserves nearly killing, refusal, and full shouting strength.

rows.en: ...But he didn't run away.
rows.notes: He=Ayato, settled explicitly by Shinji two questions at49-50. Pronoun retains deferred identification.
Context and grammatical subjects verified against original neighboring scene uses; no special ambiguity.

rows.en: He... came back. To protect what mattered to him...
rows.notes: He=Ayato; what mattered is deliberately general, with failed protection in47 and later Asahina reference corroborating.

rows.en: But he couldn't protect it.
rows.notes: He=Ayato; it=what mattered in46. Restores both grammatical references without inventing name.
Preserve wordless shock, including its later repeated use at s0210:979.

rows.en: And even then, he still...
rows.notes: Deliberate trailing off after subject; source does not complete what Ayato did despite loss.

rows.en: Ayanami... Are you talking about Ayato...!?
rows.notes: Ayanami preserves source surname address; Ayato drops honorific per brief.

rows.en: Are you talking about Ayato!?
rows.notes: Context and grammatical subjects verified against original neighboring scene uses; no special ambiguity.

rows.en: ...Shinji.
rows.notes: Context and grammatical subjects verified against original neighboring scene uses; no special ambiguity.

rows.en: K-Kaji...! Where am I...?
rows.notes: Where am I restores verb/subject to location question following dream.

rows.en: You're in a hospital room. They brought you here after that happened.
rows.notes: Context and grammatical subjects verified against original neighboring scene uses; no special ambiguity.

rows.en: U-um... Kaji... Toji...
rows.notes: Deliberate hesitant Toji fragment continued by55.

rows.en: What happened to Toji...?
rows.notes: Context and grammatical subjects verified against original neighboring scene uses; no special ambiguity.

rows.en: He's injured, but his life isn't in danger. ...And they say there's no risk of mental contamination either.
rows.notes: Kaji reports Toji medical state; mental contamination is existing source-literal provisional term.
uncertain: Mental contamination follows existing provisional source-literal glossary entry; no licensed English compound established.

rows.en: I-is that so...? Th-that's a relief...
rows.notes: Context and grammatical subjects verified against original neighboring scene uses; no special ambiguity.

rows.en: ...Shinji. The Commander wants to see you. I know you won't want to, but come with me.
rows.notes: Commander=Gendo in Shinji summons, not Isshiki in following Ayato scene; come with me is Kaji request.
Context and grammatical subjects verified against original neighboring scene uses; no special ambiguity.

rows.en: ...Ayato...
rows.notes: Context and grammatical subjects verified against original neighboring scene uses; no special ambiguity.
Repeated silence is reused across several original scene positions.

rows.en: You have a visitor.
rows.notes: Misato informs Ayato of Isshiki visit; you restored.

rows.en: Huh...?
rows.notes: Shared short reaction also occurs s0710:309 responding to Quon claiming they are human; Huh fits both.

rows.en: ...Come in, Commander Isshiki.
rows.notes: Context and grammatical subjects verified against original neighboring scene uses; no special ambiguity.

rows.en: You look surprised.
rows.notes: Context and grammatical subjects verified against original neighboring scene uses; no special ambiguity.

rows.en: Why are you here...?
rows.notes: Context and grammatical subjects verified against original neighboring scene uses; no special ambiguity.

rows.en: To take you into custody, of course. I've come in person, as the Commander of TERRA.
rows.notes: Take into custody carries transfer-of-person sense; Isshiki emphasizes own status and personal appearance.

rows.en: C-Commander...? What about Kunugi?
rows.notes: Context and grammatical subjects verified against original neighboring scene uses; no special ambiguity.

rows.en: Former Commander Kunugi was dismissed over doubts about his ability to manage the organization. He's currently confined to his home.
rows.notes: Dismissal for questioned managerial ability, followed by confinement at home, preserves all administrative claims.

rows.en: ...Are you afraid?
rows.notes: Context and grammatical subjects verified against original neighboring scene uses; no special ambiguity.

rows.en: Yes, I am. Now you can lock me up, execute me, or do whatever you like to me.
rows.notes: You=Isshiki; I/me=Ayato. Fear responds yes, then accusation of arbitrary confinement/execution.

rows.en: After what you've done... You do understand how serious it was, don't you?
rows.notes: Context and grammatical subjects verified against original neighboring scene uses; no special ambiguity.

rows.en: ...Yes.
rows.notes: Context and grammatical subjects verified against original neighboring scene uses; no special ambiguity.

rows.en: Whether you're a Mulian or not, I've disliked you from the start...
rows.notes: Whether or not Mulian preserves unconditional personal dislike, not racial-only motive.

rows.en: This man certainly doesn't mince words...
rows.notes: Misato thought uses thought brackets in measurement; man=Isshiki, sourced male.

rows.en: But I'm a fair man. My policy is to use anything that's worth using.
rows.notes: Isshiki frames himself as fair while valuing usefulness; English does not endorse claim.

rows.en: I'm not worth anything to you.
rows.notes: Context and grammatical subjects verified against original neighboring scene uses; no special ambiguity.

rows.en: That's true, except for your ability to operate the RahXephon.
rows.notes: You=Ayato, sole use=RahXephon operation.
Ayato's startled silence is a deliberate nonverbal utterance.

rows.en: All human relationships are merely matters of self-interest. You realize you're being allowed to live? By me.
rows.notes: You=Ayato, by me=Isshiki; retain claim Isshiki personally permits Ayato to live.

rows.en: Wha...!
rows.notes: Deliberate interrupted reaction.

rows.en: For now, I'll reduce your punishment somewhat in recognition of your disposal of D1 and its synchronizer. You should be grateful.
rows.notes: D1 and synchronizer are separate targets; synchronizer=Hiroko/Asahina by80 response. Disposal preserves callous euphemism; punishment reduction qualified.
uncertain: D1 synchronizer follows existing provisional literal glossary term; independent canonical English unconfirmed.

rows.en: Y-you...! What do you take Asahina for...?!
rows.notes: Ayato reacts to Isshiki calling Asahina a D1 synchronizer to be disposed of. Anger and interrupted question retained; Asahina is a person, not an object.

rows.en: Mulians aren't human. They're our enemies.
rows.notes: Isshiki answers Ayato with blunt dehumanization. Restored enemy subject.

rows.en: G-ghh...!
rows.notes: Ayato struggles to contain grief/rage; inarticulate vocalization, not omitted grammar.

rows.en: Now, we're going back. To Nirai Kanai.
rows.notes: Isshiki orders Ayato back to Nirai Kanai; restored first-person plural departure.

rows.en: ...I refuse.
rows.notes: Misato refuses Isshiki taking Ayato, politely but firmly; restored I.

rows.en: What do you mean, Major Katsuragi? I thought we'd already discussed this.
rows.notes: Isshiki addresses Misato with military rank and references their prior discussion. Major explicitly supported by glossary character rank notes for Misato.

rows.en: He's currently on loan to #部隊名.
rows.notes: Misato identifies Ayato as presently seconded to the squad; runtime squad placeholder retained verbatim.

rows.en: If you want to take him back, get permission from his commanding officer, Captain Bright... and Commander Misumaru.
rows.notes: Misato tells Isshiki to seek authorization from Bright and Misumaru. Both officers and the request direction retained; Bright uses naval Captain.

rows.en: Oh...? You intend to protect a Mulian?
rows.notes: Isshiki accuses Misato of shielding a Mulian, meaning Ayato.

rows.en: No... I'm protecting Ayato Kamina.
rows.notes: Misato names Ayato as an individual rather than accepting the racial category; restored I am protecting.

rows.en: Misato...
rows.notes: Ayato addresses Misato in gratitude/surprise. Deliberate name-only utterance.

rows.en: Very well. Talking to you gets me nowhere. I'll negotiate with Commander Ikari directly...
rows.notes: Isshiki dismisses Misato and says he will negotiate directly with Gendo Ikari.
Source silence retained; deliberate nonverbal fragment.

rows.en: ...Then you refuse to hand over the RahXephon immediately?
rows.notes: Scene changes to Helena confronting Ritsuko about immediate RahXephon handover.

rows.en: Yes. We need permission from Commander Koichiro Misumaru, who is in charge of #部隊名.
rows.notes: Ritsuko names Koichiro Misumaru as squad authority; full glossary spelling and placeholder retained.

rows.en: I see... Your counterfeit gods alone don't seem to satisfy you.
rows.notes: Helena sneers at NERV EVAs as counterfeit gods; preserves insult rather than resolving it into an explanatory gloss.

rows.en: Just what are you planning to investigate about the RahXephon?
rows.notes: Helena asks Ritsuko what she will examine in RahXephon.

rows.en: I could ask you the same thing, couldn't I?
rows.notes: Ritsuko returns Helena's suspicious question; complete reciprocal construction.

rows.en: Now, now, you two. That's enough of this staring match... I mean, discussion.
rows.notes: Itsuki breaks the confrontation; corrects staring match to discussion, retaining verbal joke.
Wordless silence used at both s06e30:213 and :269; latter follows the ruins-target inference.
Silence retained.

rows.en: Dr. Akagi, I understand your situation. But we can't go home empty-handed, either...
rows.notes: Itsuki addresses Ritsuko as Dr. Akagi and explains TERRA cannot return without a result.

rows.en: Until permission comes through, we'll stay here with the RahXephon, if you don't mind?
rows.notes: Itsuki requests remaining at NERV with RahXephon pending authorization; request direction retained.

rows.en: That's fine. But please understand that your movements will be severely restricted.
rows.notes: Ritsuko permits the stay but warns Helena/Itsuki about strict movement restrictions.

rows.en: Of course. We understand.
rows.notes: Itsuki accepts Ritsuko's conditions; explicit understood subject restored.

rows.en: Then... please excuse me. I have work to do.
rows.notes: Ritsuko excuses herself to return to work.

rows.en: ...She's just as the rumors say.
rows.notes: Helena comments on the departing Ritsuko. She refers to Ritsuko; gender from glossary.

rows.en: ...She and I might have more in common than you'd think.
rows.notes: Itsuki compares himself to Ritsuko after she departs.

rows.en: Did you decide that from her appearance?
rows.notes: Helena challenges Itsuki's visual inference.

rows.en: Yes. They say women with a mole beneath the eye are destined for heartbreak in love.
rows.notes: Itsuki invokes the superstition about a mole under the eye foretelling unhappy romance. Descriptive cultural rendering avoids unexplained tear mole terminology. Final avoids affair implying an extramarital relationship.
uncertain: Rendered the mole-under-eye romance superstition descriptively; no proper term missing from glossary.

rows.en: Well, who knows? More to the point...
rows.notes: Helena doubts the superstition and changes topic, trailing off intentionally.

rows.en: I'm glad for you, Itsuki.
rows.notes: Helena tells Itsuki this is good news for him, not congratulating herself.

rows.en: What are you glad about?
rows.notes: Itsuki asks what Helena is glad about; restored full interrogative.

rows.en: Now that the RahXephon and its Instrumentalist are back on our side...
rows.notes: Helena explains RahXephon and Ayato have returned to their side. Instrumentalist follows Akurasu canonical term. Trailing delivery retained. Now that preserves the source causal fragment responding to row108.
Reaction only; source deliberate omission preserved.

rows.en: ...But Quon...
rows.notes: Itsuki raises concern about Quon in an intentional unfinished contrast.

rows.en: She's all right. She's with my uncle now.
rows.notes: Helena reassures Itsuki that Quon is with Helena's uncle Bahbem. Uncle possessive restored without inserting absent name.

rows.en: Yes... Quon has returned to where she belongs.
rows.notes: Helena ominously frames Quon's return as her proper place.

rows.en: ...Commander, I've brought him here.
rows.notes: Kaji brings Shinji to Gendo; him is Shinji, supported by next interrogation.

rows.en: Good work.
rows.notes: Gendo acknowledges Kaji's work; conventional standalone reply.

rows.en: Disobeying orders, commandeering an EVA... childish intimidation. These are all criminal acts.
rows.notes: Gendo lists Shinji's offenses. Childish contempt and criminal accusation retained, EVA possession means commandeering.

rows.en: ...Do you have anything to say?
rows.notes: Gendo asks Shinji for a statement.

rows.en: Don't you have something you want to say to me, Dad?
rows.notes: Shinji demands an answer from his father in return, rather than apologizing.

rows.en: I'm the one asking the questions now.
rows.notes: Gendo insists he is asking the questions.
Source shock punctuation-only preserved.

rows.en: Stop it, Shinji!
rows.notes: Kaji physically restrains Shinji lunging at Gendo. Imperative directed at Shinji.

rows.en: L-let me go, Kaji!
rows.notes: Shinji tells Kaji to release him; imperative direction unambiguous.

rows.en: ...Would hitting me make you feel better?
rows.notes: Gendo asks if Shinji hitting Gendo will satisfy Shinji. You/me restored.
Shinji stammers, unable to finish. Deliberately incomplete I retained.

rows.en: I don't want to pilot an EVA anymore! I don't want to stay here, either!!
rows.notes: Shinji renounces EVA piloting and being at NERV; both clauses restored.

rows.en: I never want to see your face again, Dad!!
rows.notes: Shinji says he never wants to see his father's face again; force retained.

rows.en: Then leave. You've disappointed me.
rows.notes: Gendo expels Shinji and states personal disappointment.
Shinji silently reacts; later reuse checked.

rows.en: Go back to your teacher's home. We will never see each other again.
rows.notes: Gendo tells Shinji to return to his former teacher/guardian and dismisses any future meeting.
uncertain: Teacher is Shinji's former guardian; source does not name the teacher. Kept the relationship only.

rows.en: ...Understood... That's what I intend, too...!
rows.notes: Shinji agrees to leaving and never seeing Gendo, angrily matching the rejection.

rows.en: ...Shinji...
rows.notes: Kaji thinks Shinji's name with concern; deliberate address-only thought.

rows.en: ...It's me. Remove the Third Child from the roster...
rows.notes: Gendo speaks over communications, removing Shinji's Third Child designation from the roster, not ordering murder.
uncertain: Removal is interpreted as personnel/designation cancellation from the next pilot reassignment, not literal erasure of the person.

rows.en: Assign Rei as EVA-01's primary pilot, with the Dummy Plug as backup.
rows.notes: Gendo assigns Rei to EVA-01 as main pilot and Dummy Plug as backup; canonical EVA-01 spelling.

rows.en: You seem to be having some trouble... Commander Ikari.
rows.notes: Isshiki enters after Shinji's departure, addresses Gendo with insinuating politeness.

rows.en: ! Makoto Isshiki...
rows.notes: Kaji recognizes Makoto Isshiki; surprise plus name-only thought.

rows.en: Well, well. It's been a long time, Ryoji Kaji.
rows.notes: Isshiki recognizes Ryoji Kaji and stresses their prior acquaintance.

rows.en: ...What do you want with me, Commander Isshiki?
rows.notes: Gendo demands Isshiki's purpose; Commander Isshiki retained.

rows.en: Ayato Kamina and the RahXephon, of course.
rows.notes: Isshiki states he is there about Ayato and RahXephon.

rows.en: They belong to TERRA in the first place... I'd like you to stop this needless maneuvering behind the scenes.
rows.notes: Isshiki asserts TERRA ownership and accuses Gendo of arranging matters behind his back; maneuvering is political, not physical movement.

rows.en: Maneuvering?
rows.notes: Gendo echoes Isshiki's accusation as a skeptical question. Deliberate echo fragment.

rows.en: I'm talking about Major Misato Katsuragi. Like former Commander Kunugi, you seem unable to discipline your subordinates.
rows.notes: Isshiki specifies Misato and insults Gendo's ability to discipline staff, comparing him to Kunugi.

rows.en: Heh... The same goes for both of us.
rows.notes: Gendo turns the accusation back at Isshiki: both command structures have unruly staff.

rows.en: What do you mean?
rows.notes: Isshiki asks Gendo to explain.

rows.en: TERRA's Director Shirow Watari came here before you did.
rows.notes: Gendo reveals Director Shirow Watari already visited NERV before Isshiki.
Isshiki is shocked; source has only ellipsis/exclamation.

rows.en: When he came, regarding the fate of the RahXephon and Ayato Kamina...
rows.notes: Gendo begins explaining Watari's disposition of Ayato/RahXephon. Sentence deliberately crosses into row145. Final uses spoken regarding; continuation remains in row145, not merged.

rows.en: He told me it would be left to Commander Koichiro Misumaru, who is in charge of #部隊名.
rows.notes: Continues row144: authority is Commander Koichiro Misumaru of the squad; reported first-person knowledge retained. He is Watari; it is the fate/disposition mentioned in row144.

rows.en: Wh...at?
rows.notes: Isshiki's incredulous what stammers over its syllables.

rows.en: That is TERRA's decision. If you doubt it... confirm it directly with Director Watari.
rows.notes: Gendo tells Isshiki to check TERRA's official intent directly with Watari if he doubts it.

rows.en: You don't have to tell me. I'll be leaving...!
rows.notes: Isshiki angrily ends meeting and declares departure.

rows.en: Good grief. Every organization has its wily old foxes.
rows.notes: Kaji comments on organizational schemers, referring to the veteran maneuvering by Watari/Gendo. Wily old foxes renders old tanuki metaphor, not literal raccoons.
uncertain: Metaphor refers broadly to veteran schemers; exact singled-out individual is not specified. Kept every organization plural generalization.

rows.en: ...Ayato.
rows.notes: Itsuki addresses Ayato privately. Deliberate name-only utterance.

rows.en: Itsuki... Did you come here, too?
rows.notes: Ayato notices Itsuki is also at NERV; explicit you restored.

rows.en: Yes, to accompany the others on various matters. Well, I'll probably be going home empty-handed soon.
rows.notes: Itsuki says he accompanied the delegation on various matters and expects to return without taking RahXephon. Both ideas retained.

rows.en: ...I'm sorry. I couldn't protect your sister.
rows.notes: Ayato apologizes for failing to protect Quon, Itsuki's sister; relationship retained rather than substituting name.

rows.en: I said I'd protect her... but I couldn't even keep that promise.
rows.notes: Ayato says he broke his promise to protect Quon; wordplay on protecting person/keeping word naturally rendered.

rows.en: Don't worry about it. Quon is doing fine.
rows.notes: Itsuki reassures Ayato Quon is well, contradicting Ayato's fears.

rows.en: What...!?
rows.notes: Ayato's surprise serves both Kim's bereavement and Reika's summons at use280.

rows.en: I couldn't protect my sister either. We're alike in that respect... aren't we?
rows.notes: Itsuki admits same failure to protect Quon and suggests similarity to Ayato, with later family revelation as subtext.
Ayato does not understand Itsuki's comparison; source punctuation only.

rows.en: Is Haruka doing well?
rows.notes: Itsuki asks Ayato about Haruka's wellbeing, starting a romantic-subtext exchange.

rows.en: I think she is...
rows.notes: Ayato answers Itsuki's question about Haruka; I think she is restores context-supported subject/verb.

rows.en: I see.
rows.notes: Itsuki acknowledges Ayato saying Haruka is probably well.

rows.en: ...Um...so you really...
rows.notes: Ayato hesitantly starts asking about Itsuki and Haruka; deliberate unfinished question.

rows.en: So I really...what?
rows.notes: Itsuki prompts Ayato to finish the preceding hesitation; mirrors really.

rows.en: You and Haruka are...well...
rows.notes: Deliberate unfinished question about Itsuki and Haruka, not a subject omission.

rows.en: ...Ha ha ha...You're still a child.
rows.notes: Context and referents verified against full original neighbors; natural spoken English, source force retained.

rows.en: She's been in love with one man all this time. But he hasn't even noticed.
rows.notes: She is Haruka (sourced female); the man is implicitly Ayato, confirmed by the big brother thought at173. Do not expose that identity in the spoken line.

rows.en: ...That's awful.
rows.notes: Context and referents verified against full original neighbors; natural spoken English, source force retained.

rows.en: Is that what you think?
rows.notes: Context and referents verified against full original neighbors; natural spoken English, source force retained.

rows.en: ...I feel sorry for Haruka.
rows.notes: Context and referents verified against full original neighbors; natural spoken English, source force retained.

rows.en: ...You're cruel...
rows.notes: Cruel is aimed at Ayato;170 explicitly supplies the referent after reused Ayato reaction.

rows.en: Huh?
rows.notes: Adjacent dialogue settles speaker/listener and referent; English retains complete subject/action.

rows.en: I mean you...saying something like that so casually.
rows.notes: Answer to reused Ayato reaction at original187; completes who was cruel in169.

rows.en: ...We're alike...Of course we are.
rows.notes: We means Itsuki and Ayato; retains dramatic ellipses.

rows.en: It's a tragedy...Even though we bear the same mark of Xephon.
rows.notes: We restores Itsuki and Ayato as shared bearers; mark of Xephon retained without extra explanation.

rows.en: ...You're cruel, big brother.
rows.notes: Source explicitly addresses Ayato as elder brother in private thought; no speculative relationship expansion.

rows.en: ...You aren't going to reconsider, are you, Shinji?
rows.notes: Context and referents verified against full original neighbors; natural spoken English, source force retained.

rows.en: Yes.
rows.notes: Shinji accepts his assignment.

rows.en: I'm sure you understand, but from now on...your movements will be severely restricted.
rows.notes: Misato warns Shinji about restrictions after his refusal to pilot; movements, not robotic mobility.

rows.en: Um...
